answer: Attention Ledger Mechanism.** Each identity must continuously solve randomized micro-tasks whose answers are verifiable but only derivable by sustained, serial attention; rewards accrue in a ledger that decays without ongoing participation. To forge a durable identity, an attacker must divert real attention-time from a sable pool of parallel accounts, since a bot cannot split genuine cognitive work across many identities. Onboarding on a new island of trust requires a minimum ledger balance, so each sybil costs hours of unrecoverable human attention.
